title: Chiffon's Baking
description: Anything baking related is themed around Chiffon!
body:
Replaces the cake block and item textures with a new pink sugary version based on my OC "Chiffon"'s baking style!

Specifically.. makes the cake have a cherry on top and pink icing and a more saturated crust.
I hope you like it!

![Cake block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef3343fb073b45a72a2026960bde37e4264e0a06.png)

_Should work with most versions of Minecraft, it is just a simple cake re-texture.._
_Project files included!_
